header: When heating, water or a cold store fails
text: Answered every day of the year, including nights and public holidays. A technician calls back within 30 minutes. With a maintenance contract, a technician is on the way within four hours.
note: Call-outs outside 07:00 to 17:00 on working days cost extra. We quote the surcharge on the phone before anyone sets off. The number is free from Austrian networks.
